messages:
Priya Shah (Support): heads up — handing off a P1 to CS. BrightPath pilot blocked: SSO provisioning returning 403 after their key rotation. Renewal conversation in ~28 days, customer warned about pausing if not fixed quickly. Can CS take this?

Alex Kim (Customer Success): on it. give me last error ids and a direct contact for BrightPath. I'll join the triage.

Priya Shah (Support): error ids: e1b2c3, f4g5h6, z9y8x7. Contact: Sophie Tran (sophie@brightpath.com). Started after they rotated keys yesterday. Support tried re-provisioning token + worker restart, no luck. Marked as P1 in support queue.

Dan O'Neill (Account Exec): flagging renewal risk — Sophie said she'll consider pausing the pilot if not resolved by EOD tomorrow. Proposed comms plan: 1) triage + customer sync within 2h, 2) temporary manual token workaround, 3) follow-up enablement + postmortem. @Alex please assign owner.

Alex Kim (Customer Success): I'll own the triage + sync. @Maya Li can you validate infra (token acceptance logs) and see if our KMS rotation impacted BrightPath tokens? Need a quick yes/no on whether Hosted vs Dedicated behavior differs.

Maya Li (SRE): looking at logs for tenant_id=bp-8892 now. Note: our global KMS rotated a root key yesterday 03:12 UTC and we had a 2h grace window; possible edge-case missed. I'll check alias mappings and token validation flow. ETA ~45m.

Priya Shah (Support): Sophie available 1pm PT today. I'll hold that slot. Sharing KB: https://kb.redwood.ai/onboarding/sso-troubleshoot and quick curl test: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision`

Alex Kim (Customer Success): Plan: 1) 1pm PT triage call with Sophie + Priya + me; 2) Maya validate infra and prepare rollback/alias remap if needed; 3) If no fix within 2h of call, offer manual token upload + 50% credit toward pilot (Dan approved). Priya, please draft the customer-facing note in a calm tone.

Dan O'Neill (Account Exec): credit workaround approved. CC'ing finance for billing adjustments.

Maya Li (SRE): quick update — found 2 failed auth rejects for bp-8892 caused by missing key alias mapping after rotation. I've temporarily remapped the alias to the old key for their tenant. Should be passing now.

Priya Shah (Support): Sophie confirms provisioning flows are green. She thanks the team for quick turnaround 🙂. I'll schedule a postmortem for tomorrow to cover root cause + remediation steps.

Alex Kim (Customer Success): thanks all. Action items: Maya — create JIRA for KMS alias mapping + add regression test; Priya — send the customer note and schedule postmortem; Dan — confirm billing credit entry; I'll run enablement session Wed 10am PT. We'll close the support ticket once postmortem is scheduled. :tada:
